summary: KeyCorp filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, announcing the redemption of all 525,000 depositary shares representing its Series D Fixed-to-Floating Rate Perpetual Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, with an aggregate liquidation preference of $525 million. Redemption will occur on September 15, 2026, at $1,012.50 per depositary share ($25,312.50 per preferred share), equal to liquidation preference plus accrued dividends. Shares are held in book-entry form through DTC. This is a mandatory contractual redemption, not a tender offer. Watch for the redemption date and potential reinvestment by preferred holders.
